moments.title: Premier League Saturday Showdowns
moments.blurb: Three big Premier League clashes today include Aston Villa vs Man City, Arsenal vs Everton, and Chelsea vs Tottenham.

angles.name: Match Day Excitement
angles.copy: It's a huge Saturday in the Premier League! Who are you backing today? Catch Aston Villa v Man City, Arsenal v Everton, and Chelsea v Tottenham.

moments.title: Welsh Artist Jamie Miller Tops UK Chart
moments.blurb: Welsh singer Jamie Miller has scored his first UK number one single with 'Babydoll,' making him the first Welsh artist to top the charts in 15 years, and the first male solo Welsh artist in 41 years.

angles.name: Wales Celebrates Chart Topper
angles.copy: Massive congratulations to Welsh artist Jamie Miller! His track 'Babydoll' is officially the UK Number 1, making history for Wales! What a moment!

angles.name: New Music King
angles.copy: Your new UK Number 1 is Jamie Miller with 'Babydoll'! Get ready to hear it everywhere. What do you think of the new chart-topper?

moments.title: Happy 29th Birthday, RAYE!
moments.blurb: Today, British singer-songwriter RAYE celebrates her 29th birthday. She had a UK number-one single in January 2026 with 'Where Is My Husband!' and performed at the Royal Albert Hall yesterday.

angles.name: Birthday Shoutout
angles.copy: Big birthday shoutout to the incredible RAYE, who turns 29 today! Hope you're celebrating after your Royal Albert Hall show last night!

angles.name: Music Star Birthday
angles.copy: From a UK Number 1 to a Royal Albert Hall gig, what a year for RAYE! Sending the happiest of birthdays as she turns 29.
